Per-service RED metrics (throughput, error rate, p50/p95/p99 latency), with
overview totals and optional per-service trend sparklines and
previous-window comparison deltas.

Served from a pre-aggregated rollup, so this is much cheaper than the
equivalent query against raw spans.
